title: Force LR Exploration in S11 + Add home_next Lookahead Feature

status_check.note: LR already in engine, scheduling features already in engine. Problem: LR never selected by GA across 6 islands (all using tree models). Tree-based plateau confirmed: Brier unchanged for 2+ consecutive brain cycles.

motivation.plateau_observation: All 6 islands show IDENTICAL Brier scores across 2+ consecutive brain cycles. S14 gen advanced 1056→1145 (+89 gens) with ZERO Brier improvement. Extra_trees dominates all top spots.
motivation.why_lr_not_selected: Tree models have early-generation advantage in GA because they can overfit training well. LR needs proper initialization. GA is not discovering LR through random mutation alone.
motivation.key_research_finding: MDPI Information 17(1):56 (Jan 2026): Logistic Regression achieves Brier=0.199 on NBA tabular data — BELOW our target 0.21837. XGBoost: Brier=0.202. Both evaluated with chronological split.

citations.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
citations.key_result: LR: Brier=0.199 (best tabular). XGBoost: Brier=0.202. LSTM+BrierLoss: best calibration. Monte Carlo Dropout: best uncertainty quantification.

citations.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
citations.key_result: SHAP top-3: (1) home_next = next game is home (lookahead), (2) team_elo_5y, (3) team_elo. home_next is different from b2b — it's a strategic rest signal.

proposed_changes.description: POST /api/command {"action": "inject_model_type", "model_type": "logistic_regression", "count": 10} to S11 to seed 10 LR individuals into population. This forces GA to explore LR before discarding it.
proposed_changes.alternative: Modify init_population() to always include min 20% LR individuals in starting population for S11
proposed_changes.expected_impact: If LR achieves Brier < 0.220 on our 59-feature set, it enters the Pareto front and gets migrated to other islands

proposed_changes.description: Add home_next lookahead feature (Cat47 or extend Cat6)
proposed_changes.logic: For home team: 1 if their NEXT scheduled game (game i+1) is at home, 0 if away. For away team: same. This is different from h_b2b — it captures strategic load management: teams may rest stars in current game if next game is important home game.
proposed_changes.implementation_notes: Requires schedule data with future game locations. NBA schedule is available via nba_api. Add to Cat6 (REST & SCHEDULE) as h_next_home, a_next_home, next_home_diff.
proposed_changes.current_coverage: Cat6 has h_b2b (back-to-back) and rest_days, but NOT lookahead to next game home/away. This gap matches SHAP finding #1.

proposed_changes.description: Wrap all models with CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=5) after training. Use Brier score to select best calibration method (sigmoid, isotonic, none).
proposed_changes.based_on: MDPI paper: sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV used with Brier-based selection achieves LR Brier=0.199
proposed_changes.current_state: Unknown if CalibratedClassifierCV is applied in current code
proposed_changes.expected_impact: 0.5-1.5% Brier improvement on all model types

deploy_plan.step1: POST /api/command inject_model_type to S11 (exploration island) to seed 10 LR individuals
deploy_plan.step2: Monitor S11 Brier for next 2 cycles (8h)
deploy_plan.step3: If S11 finds LR Brier < 0.219, roll out LR seeding to S10 and S14 (exploitation islands)
deploy_plan.step4: Add home_next_game to features/engine.py + sync to all 6 HF spaces (engine parity)
deploy_plan.constraint: One change at a time. LR seeding first, home_next feature second.

expected_outcome.path_to_target: LR Brier=0.199 in literature with ~60 features. Our feature set (59 features, Cat1-46) is similar. If we can break 0.219, we're in striking distance of 0.21837 target.

cross_project_note: PA apply_patches.py FIX6 already adds LR to PA CPU_MODEL_TYPES. Once PA bootstrap is fixed, same LR-seeding strategy applies there.
